=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:63 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The concurrency group for scheduled runs uses github.run_id, so every scheduled run gets a unique group name and new runs never replace pending ones.
  WHY: This can lead to unbounded concurrent scan runs that exhaust GitHub API limits. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus explicitly judged this a misreading, because the recovery-scan job joins the shared group at job level.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:241-249,293-296 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: When closing an already-replaced issue fails and the attempt marker also fails to post, `_post_attempt_marker` returns 0 without recording an attempt or sending a WARNING.
  WHY: The issue stays a candidate every hour and the failure repeats silently. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said MAJOR, and the others said NIT. The highest is used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:235,248 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: For `close_failed` the marker comment and final WARNING tell the operator to produce a fresh authenticated failure report, but the issue is already replaced and only needs a manual close.
  WHY: The wording misdirects the paged operator toward an action that will not help.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh: `already_replaced` branch (`CLOSE_STATE="failed"` calling `_post_attempt_marker`) and early `return 0` in `_post_attempt_marker` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If closing an already-replaced issue fails and the marker comment also fails to post, no attempt is recorded and no alert is sent.
  WHY: `scan_attempts` stays the same, so the issue remains a candidate every hour. The scan exits 0 and only log lines show it. This needs two independent write failures, so it is unlikely.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh, `case "${REASON}"` deferral branch. A reason that keeps deferring (for example `budget_budget_exhausted`) records no attempt and sends no alert. Suggested fix: log a `deferred_streak` line after N consecutive deferrals, or send one WARNING.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh, `_post_attempt_marker` body text and WARNING text for `close_failed`. The wording says a fresh report is needed, but the issue only needs a manual close. Suggested fix: branch the wording on `reason=close_failed`.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Task gaps: NONE.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:63 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The concurrency group for scheduled runs uses github.run_id.
  WHY: Every scheduled run gets a unique group name, which can lead to unbounded concurrent scan runs, API exhaustion and a violated idempotency contract.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:293-296 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If closing an already-replaced issue fails, the warning is only sent when the attempt marker is successfully posted.
  WHY: If both the close and the marker post fail, no warning is sent and the issue is retried indefinitely without notification.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:(Inside _post_attempt_marker) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The attempt marker comment and final WARNING message wrongly instruct the operator to produce a fresh authenticated failure report.
  WHY: The issue is already replaced and only needs a manual close, so the message wastes triage resources.

  WHY: A person paged by the third-attempt WARNING is told to produce a new report, when the right action is to close the issue manually.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:241-249 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the `gh api` marker comment fails, the function logs `marker=failed` and returns 0 without reaching the `attempts+1 >= MAX_ATTEMPTS` WARNING branch.
  WHY: The old code sent a `tg_send_msg WARNING` on every failed close. If both the close and the marker post keep failing, no alert is ever sent and the scan exits 0 every hour.
